newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-PARLIAMENT STICKS TO BASEMENT GAMBLING BAN.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-PARLIAMENT STICKS TO BASEMENT GAMBLING BAN.

text.p: Latvia's parliament on Thursday decided to stick to amendments to the law on lotteries and gambling which bans gambling businesses to be run in basements.
President Guntis Ulmanis sent the law back to parliament for reconsideration after it was passed on March 24.
Ulmanis referred to some 1.6 million lats in tax revenue which would be lost to the state coffers.
Ulmanis cannot object to a repeated parliament decision.

A politician from one of the three biggest parliament factions, who refused to be identified, said that it would very soon hand in amendments to the law, which allow gambling businesses to be situated in cellars.
